newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL HOPE TO SIGN INCE IN NEXT FEW DAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL HOPE TO SIGN INCE IN NEXT FEW DAYS.

text.p: Liverpool hope to complete the signing of England international midfielder Paul Ince from Italy's Internazionale in the next few days.

"There are one or two things to sort out," manager Roy Evans said on the club's telephone service for fans on Wednesday. "I hope to sort things out this week or early next week. Hopefully in the next three to four days."
Ince has said he will leave Inter before the start of the new season and has been linked to several English sides including Arsenal and Blackburn as well as Liverpool.
